name: Snag Triangle Spacing
formation: Gun Spread Right Slot, TE Right

summary.motive: Attack Cover 3 with three-layer spacing that puts every single defender in an impossible high-low conflict.
summary.whyItWorks: The run-action freeze delays every underneath drop exactly long enough for the triangle layers to establish separation in their three separate windows.
summary.failureMode: Linebackers play slow-to-the-ball discipline through the run fake, keeping their drops intact and crowding both underneath windows.

beats.title: 1. Run Action Freezes the Box
beats.text: The identical zone-read mesh sends every linebacker and the robber triggering downhill while the quarterback resets his feet to throw.

beats.title: 2. The Triangle Builds
beats.text: Three receivers stack vertically on the right at three depths: the back in the flat, the tight end settling at five, and the wideout breaking the corner at twelve.

beats.title: 3. Snag Wins vs the Hook
beats.text: The Mike's eyes were frozen by run action, so the snag settles directly behind his drop while he chases depth he can never recover.

beats.title: 4. High-Low Finish
beats.text: If the flat defender drives on the catch, the corner route is open behind him; if he sinks, the snag is easy money. The triangle guarantees one is free.

relations.tell: The running back releases to the flat instead of carrying a dive fake — live read-option plays never send the back away from the mesh.
